post.originalText:
Same prompt, one shot: an interactive first-person spaceship cockpit with an Earth-to-Mars warp jump in Three.js.

- Claude Opus 5.5: 41m 18s | ~23.6M tokens | $11.77
- GPT-6.1 Sol: 23m 40s | ~9.6M tokens | $2.15

Costs are estimated API prices.

Sol went for a clean, hard sci-fi aesthetic with sharp vector telemetry and a classic hyperspace starfield. But Opus turned the cockpit into a full sci-fi cockpit with warm interior lighting, animated holo-radar, and a chromatic warp tunnel.

A 5.5x price difference. Which warp jump feels more immersive to you?
